title: incident-bot: refactor runbook autodiagnostics + oncall helpers (telemetry + API surface)
author: Ava Chen
description: Refactor the incident-bot runbook autodiagnostics subsystem and oncall helpers to: 1) separate diagnostics extraction from presentation, 2) standardize SLO/context payloads between slo-toolkit and incident-bot, and 3) add telemetry hooks for diagnostics ranking and quicklink selection. Motivation: recent incidents exposed brittle runbook linking logic and duplicated SLO formatting between services which made it hard to iterate on ranking improvements. This PR extracts a small diagnostics core (parse + score + suggestions), wires a stable HTTP API for other services (slo-toolkit, oncall), and upgrades the oncall quicklink helpers to use the new scoring signals. Checklist: - [x] extract diagnostics core and add unit tests - [x] add HTTP API with schema validation and backwards-compatible endpoints - [x] add telemetry events (diag_generated, quicklink_selected, suggestion_rank) - [x] update slo-toolkit integration and add e2e smoke test - [x] docs: internal runbook and oncall helper guide - [x] run CI and fix lint/test failures Notes: kept the old endpoints (POST /v1/diagnostics/lookup) as a compatibility shim that delegates to the new core. Also added a feature flag (diag_refactor_v2) controlled by infra to roll out slowly. Related Linear: ENG-1428, ENG-2103. Related incident: INC-2026 (followup).
commits: Extract diagnostics core module with parser + scorer + suggestion builder
Add HTTP adapter and schema validation (pydantic -> runtime checks)
Wire telemetry events and add structured logging for ranking decisions
Compatibility shim for existing POST /v1/diagnostics/lookup endpoint
Update slo-toolkit integration to POST canonical SLO payloads
Add unit tests for scorer edge cases and e2e smoke test for oncall quicklinks
review_comments: Marcus Li: Can we make the scorer deterministic by seeding the tie-breaker with request_id? Observed flakiness in tests.
Ava Chen: Good catch — added tie-break seed using canonical request id. Updated tests.
Priya Kapoor: The HTTP schema change looks fine, but please keep the compatibility shim and document the deprecation timeline.
Ava Chen: Added deprecation note to docs and kept shim behavior unchanged when feature flag is off.
Diego Alvarez: Telemetry event names look good. Add an attribute for model_variant where available.
Ava Chen: Added model_variant to telemetry payload and included an example in docs.
release_notes: Refactored incident-bot runbook autodiagnostics: extracted diagnostics core, stable API for SLO/context payloads, telemetry for ranking, and oncall quicklink improvements. Backwards-compatible shim kept; feature-flagged rollout.
